539:t_014:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$フィアナ$$... You don't mean...!」

539:t_014:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that's some unusually happy news!」

539:t_014:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That fact alone made coming here worthwhile.」

539:t_014:11.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I will destroy the one who twisted my fate and $$フィアナ$$'s.」

539:t_015:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Today, $$マーティアル$$... and its god will perish.」

539:t_015:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「For my future with $$フィアナ$$.」

539:t_016:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I have confirmed $$マーティアル$$'s destruction.」

539:t_016:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Perhaps they too were victims, controlled by one who falsely claimed to be God...」

539:t_016:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And $$キリコ・キュービィー$$ is the man who refused to yield to him.」

539:t_017:2.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Search for enemies!」

539:t_017:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You guys really still have a long way to go.」

539:t_018:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「This is bad! My $$エクルビス$$ can't hold out anymore!!」

539:t_018:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「B-but if I lose this machine, I can't keep working as a mercenary!」

539:t_019:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it! Damn you, $$キリコ$$! $$シャッコ$$, $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! Damn you, $c!!」

539:t_019:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Remember this! One day I'll make you understand how great I am!」

539:t_020:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「What happened to $$カン・ユー$$!?」

539:t_020:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Who knows? That man is stubborn. He may still be alive.」

539:t_020:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「I don't care either way. If he comes back as an enemy, we'll just fight him again.」

539:t_020:6.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「You have no interest, then.」

539:t_020:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You went unrewarded to the very end, $$カン・ユー$$.」

539:t_021:0.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「You who denied my existence... will surely regret it...」

539:t_021:1.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「You cannot... overcome the future... of despair. In the true... collapse once every 120 million years, the universe... all of space-time... will vanish... completely!」

539:t_021:2.en:
$$桂$$
「For a guy who called himself God, he's awfully pessimistic.」

539:t_021:3.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「$$始原の特異点$$... You cannot... overturn... that fate.」

539:t_021:4.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「If this warped space-time... can be repaired... then it... that being...」

539:t_021:5.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Can only... be... a god...」

539:t_021:7.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「$$キリコ$$... You will... regret... not accepting... me...」

539:t_021:8.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「What awaits... you is a future... of despair.........」

539:t_022:1.en:
$$桂$$
「It looks like what the collective unconscious told us was for real...」

539:t_022:3.en:
$$桂$$
「We... and $$キリコ$$... have no intention of obeying a guy who toys with other people's lives and fate.」

539:t_022:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$... This world does not need you.)

539:t_022:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Neither I nor my comrades will ever obey someone like you. Even if that being is called a god...)

539:t_100:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$! The time has finally come!」

539:t_100:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Our feud has gone on a long time, when I think about it... And now it ends here!」

539:t_100:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「With my victory, of course!」

539:t_100:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「It's too late to cry and beg for forgiveness! You went too far, $$キリコ$$! Prepare yourself!」

539:t_100:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

539:t_100:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I am going through, $$カン・ユー$$. I have no use for you.」

539:t_100:7.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you bastard! You finally say my name, only to mock me to the very end!?」

539:t_101:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$カレン$$! So the time has come to settle things with you too!」

539:t_101:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「You're so persistent, $$カン・ユー$$! I couldn't care less about you!」

539:t_101:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「But if you're going to get in $$キリコ$$'s way, I'll take you on!」

539:t_101:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「I've got plenty of grudges against you, too!!」

539:t_101:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you...! You're bringing personal feelings onto the battlefield!?」

539:t_101:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's that hypocritical crap, ignoring how you do the same thing, that pisses me off!!」

539:t_102:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$... Even if I defeat you, my battle and $$フィアナ$$'s probably will not end...)

539:t_102:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Then we will keep fighting. Beyond the despair you speak of...)

539:t_103:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$, you false god... Your existence is gradually giving the image within my mind a clearer form.)

539:t_103:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But can we do it as we are now...? Can we overcome the future of despair...?)

539:t_104:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$, you people with special powers...! I cannot forgive your arrogance in calling yourselves greater than humans!」

539:t_104:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Heroes of $$クエント$$! Give me the strength to destroy him!」

539:t_105:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You called yourself God, but in the end, you were only a petty man trying to control others.」

539:t_105:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You were still too immature to climb the stairway to godhood.」
